thread:
alex: vendor asked for KMS proxy + RBAC export and a vuln tracker link. who owns coordination?
morgan: I can own coordination. timeline? vendor proposed a 6h window next Thursday.
priya: 6h is fine. i'll run RBAC snapshot and exclude CI/service accounts per policy.
ingrid: logging note: they want raw audit ordering + request_id. we'll provide cloudtrail.json and app-audit.json. presigned URLs preferred.
james: KMS plan: ephemeral role with minimal decrypt/list scoped to alias/test-key, TTL 6h. key usage will be logged to key-usage-audit stream.
ops-oncall: Ops needs 48h notice. we will rotate readroom creds immediately after the window and run the credential-rotation playbook.
alex: remediation flow proposal: create SEC ticket "assessor-inbound". SLA: ack within 12h, initial triage 24h, fix ETA 5d for P2. sound reasonable?
priya: sounds good. snapshot commands i'll run (example):
```
./tools/rbac-snapshot --out /tmp/rbac-175601.json
sha256sum /tmp/rbac-175601.json > /tmp/rbac-175601.sha256
gsutil cp /tmp/rbac-175601.json gs://evidence-exports/assessments/175601/rbac-base.json
gsutil cp /tmp/rbac-175601.sha256 gs://evidence-exports/assessments/175601/
```
james: runtime traces: capture two 90s samples (startup + steady-state) focused on kv_evictions; output runtime-traces.tar.gz and include manifest with md5s.
ingrid: retention: presigned links max 30d per ops, but we'll mirror objects to evidence-archive with 90d retention and record checksums for chain-of-custody.
morgan: retest booking: ops, can you reserve a contingent slot within 72h for P1/P2 fixes (morning block)?
ops-oncall: Holding Mon/Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC as contingent retest slots. infra-impact fixes may need staging and we'll flag that.
alex: please include a README in the bundle describing redactions, fields included, and the exact commands used to produce snapshots and traces.
morgan: action list: priya -> RBAC snapshot + upload; james -> ephemeral KMS role + runtime traces; ingrid -> audit exports + retention manifest; ops -> block retest slots + rotation; alex -> draft SLA wording and update ticket.
security-bot: Created SEC-3301: "Assessor handshake & evidence flow" and added checklist (RBAC snapshot, presigned bundle, KMS ephemeral role, runtime traces, retention mirror). Dry-run scheduled 2026-03-05 14:00 UTC.
